description.narrative: IFC is considering an equity investment of up to US$20m into Tanmiya Capital Ventures Fund II Coöperatief U.A (TCV II, or the Fund), a fund targeting US$150m (hard cap of US$150m). TCV II is an Egypt-focused Growth capital PE fund planning to invest in growing mid cap companies across diversified sectors which include food & beverage, logistics, pharmaceuticals, healthcare, and higher education. The Fund aims to foster the institutionalization of family businesses in Egypt and focuses on the wider additionality of availing growth capital funding for successful Egyptian midcap companies.

The Fund is expected to increase access to private equity capital and value creation for mid-cap companies operating in Egypt. PE investments in Egypt have recently revived but remain below the emerging market average, with a decline in the mid-cap segment over the past 5 years. Despite the recent structural reforms, recent macroeconomic headwinds in Egypt have increased risk perception among commercial investors, leading to heavy reliance on DFI support for most funds. TCV aims to provide value creation to local businesses through improved operational efficiency, growth, and profitability; and improved ESG standards. Beyond the project, IFC's support for a local player supports its strategy to develop skilled, long-term fund managers in Egypt's PE market, signaling the commercial viability of the Egyptian market and encouraging entry of new or existing managers with country-focused funds.
